forward.name: Axeyum.Autogenesis.intNatAbsDvdForwardResidualV1
forward.statement: for every supplied natAbs-multiplication proof and a b : Int, a divides b implies a.natAbs divides b.natAbs
forward.method: eliminate the Int divisibility witness, reuse its natAbs as the Nat witness, and close with the supplied multiplication equality

reverse.name: Axeyum.Autogenesis.intDvdOfNatAbsDvdDirectV1
reverse.statement: forall a b : Int, a.natAbs divides b.natAbs implies a divides b
reverse.method: eliminate the Nat witness, split only on the two Int constructors, and choose ofNat witness for equal signs or negOfNat witness for opposite signs

next_on_accept: export and qualify both witness transports, then specialize the forward residual with intNatAbsMulDirectV1
